name: owl-decomp
label: Sówka — the reference picture taken apart (C2)
verdict: C2 · best The rest pose is the reference picture, so nothing looks pasted together. Hidden areas (under the wing, under the hat, under the head) were painted by Nano Banana edits; blink and sing are edits of the same picture that line up to the pixel (overlap 0.998), cut where they differ. Pivots were found automatically from where parts touch. v3 (your notes): the head under the hat keeps only a 45 px band of skull — the fill had painted a whole second ear there; wings lift from the shoulder and draw above the head's side fur; the far wing hides behind the body until it flaps.
